name: Borchen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, blue and yellow with a broad blue middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Borchen (a yellow spiral and wavy bends on blue).
history: On the basis of the deed of 18 September 1975 the municipality of Borchen bears the flag described in its charter.

features.role: Borchen arms — spiral and wavy bends on blue
